scripts.install:all: pnpm --dir backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "pnpm --dir backend start:dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --dir backend build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.start: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "pnpm --dir backend start:prod" "npm --prefix frontend run start"
